resources.string: Preview and merge a LibreTube JSON backup into the current profile

Export a JSON backup from LibreTube with the categories you want, then select it here (up to 16 MiB and 50,000 entries). Existing WizeStream data is kept.

LibreTube does not store watch timestamps: new history entries use the import time. Existing playback positions take priority. Local playlists receive a LibreTube suffix; identical lists are not imported twice.

Settings, accounts, downloads and search history are not imported. This does not export data back to LibreTube.
